C1247.title: Chinese-American Men Arrested in California for Tampering with Gift Cards to Steal Funds
C1247.summary: In August 2025, police in Santa Rosa, California arrested Yongsheng Zhao and Zhipeng Li, saying they were suspected of carrying out gift card draining fraud across California. Suspects removed gift cards from retail shelves, recorded or altered activation information, repackaged and returned the cards, and funds were quickly transferred after consumers loaded value. Police said they seized about 25,000 suspected altered gift cards and other evidence, and investigated or filed the case under multiple charges. The case reflects theft risk when physical gift cards lack validation before and after activation, packaging can be restored, and balance monitoring is delayed.
